findings.title: External archival evidence
findings.assertion: The systemd service runs the harness and exports locally but neither publishes nor externally timestamps the forecast evidence; week 12 relied on a manual GitHub push.
findings.requirement: Specification §3.4 frozen-before-outcome evidence; AUD-01 prospective confirmation (AUDIT_REMEDIATION_AND_COMPLETION_REQUIREMENTS.md remediation 1).
implementationAtReview: infra/systemd/arbit-dvp-prospective.service.template:14 exports to artifacts/dvp/prospective/export (git-ignored)
scripts/model/dvp_prospective.py:501 export() copies files; nothing pushes them
evidence: The service template at 2e2520f has no publication step.

GitHub activity API: week 12's files reached GitHub in the push of 168196d to claude/m3-dvp-prospective at 2026-11-24T23:13:15Z, a manual step; their bytes equal the ledger's forecasts.csv, manifest.json and league.json hashes.
tests: libs/arbit-model/tests/test_dvp_evidence.py (6 tests against a local bare remote)
Live: week 12 commitment published to research-evidence/dvp-prospective, read back equal, GitHub activity timestamp 2026-11-25T03:46:49Z (before the 2026-11-26T01:00Z cutoff)
findings.reasoning: An unattended local export has no independent timestamp; local commit dates are set by the machine.
findings.remediation: arbit_model.dvp.evidence: a sanitized commitment (ledger entry and file hashes, forecasts CSV; league capture as a hash only) committed from a dedicated clone to research-evidence/dvp-prospective, read back and compared, with GitHub's repository activity record as the timestamp. Attempts, results and failures are hash-chained in publications.jsonl; failed publication is retried without regenerating. Week 12's earlier push recorded as verified prior evidence.
findings.expectedEffect: None on forecasts; a week counts as prospective only with a verified external commitment before its cutoff (amendment 1).
findings.completionCriteria: Commitments for every archived week verified before its cutoff; the timer publishes unattended with a repository-scoped credential.
findings.statusNote: Mechanism built and verified live for week 12. The repository-scoped deploy key is generated locally but its registration on GitHub needs the owner (the permission classifier refused the registration); until then the timer's publications fail visibly, alert and retry.

findings.title: Source ingestion and data readiness
findings.assertion: The harness rebuilds targets from local nflverse files but does not establish that they are refreshed in time.
findings.requirement: AUD-01; specification §4 data eligibility and point-in-time rules.
implementationAtReview: scripts/model/dvp_prospective.py readiness(): waits for earlier games without a result and completed games with no FFA lines at all
evidence: The worker's statistics lane (services/worker/src/arbit_worker/daemon.py StatisticsLane) imports changed nflverse files daily; dataset_manifest shows stats_player_week_2026 imported 2026-11-22, -23 and -24 at about 22:50 UTC.
The old readiness accepted a completed game with any line; a game with 5 of its 12 cells would pass.
tests: Live sweep 2026-11-25: week 13 WAITING with 162 ELIGIBLE_VERIFIED, 1 RETRIEVED_INVALID, 16 AWAITING_RESULT
findings.reasoning: The refresh dependency exists (the worker's daily statistics lane) and readiness already waited for results; but completeness was checked per game, not per cell, and the blocking cause was not classified.
findings.remediation: window.game_readiness: every earlier game gets ELIGIBLE_VERIFIED, RETRIEVED_INVALID, AWAITING_RESULT, POSTPONED_OR_CANCELED, NOT_YET_AVAILABLE, SOURCE_NOT_YET_PUBLISHED, PUBLISHED_NOT_RETRIEVED or DATA_INTEGRITY_FAILURE, using all 12 cells and the nflverse file revision held versus the newest in Arbit's catalog. status.json records each run's outcome; waiting within 18 hours of a cutoff or failing raises an alert. The harness never imports data itself.
findings.expectedEffect: None on forecasts; fewer silent waits.
findings.completionCriteria: Per-game states recorded in every run and archive manifest; alert path verified.

findings.title: Complete prospective evaluation window
findings.assertion: A week counted as completed when any of its games was completed; MISSED weeks satisfied the window requirement.
implementationAtReview: scripts/model/dvp_prospective.py:1004-1011 (weeks_done = weeks with any completed game; status PROSPECTIVE or MISSED)
evidence: Code at 2e2520f, lines cited.

config/dvp/prospective.json (declared 2026-11-24) itself allowed missed weeks to be excluded with a confirmation still possible: the implementation matched its declaration; the declared rule was too weak.
The old test test_only_the_complete_prospective_window_can_confirm only checked label replacement.
tests: libs/arbit-model/tests/test_dvp_window.py: 12 gate tests (first game only, several unfinished, labels missing, missed week, retrospective for a missed week, full valid window, subset, timing failure, integrity failure, duplicates, postponed game, invalid labels)
findings.reasoning: A single completed game marked the week complete, and a missed week could still lead to CONFIRMED.
findings.remediation: arbit_model.dvp.window (archive_state, label_state, window_state) under config/dvp/prospective-amendment-1.json, declared and pushed (463a6c0, 2026-11-25 03:37 UTC) before the first week-12 kickoff. A missed week makes INCOMPLETE_WINDOW; only COMPLETE allows CONFIRMED/NOT_CONFIRMED, separately for Phase B and C. prospective.json and the week-12 archive unchanged.
findings.expectedEffect: Stricter: confirmation now needs all seven weeks archived, externally committed before their cutoffs and fully labelled.
findings.completionCriteria: Gate tests pass; evaluate uses the gate.

findings.title: Archival transaction integrity
findings.assertion: Folder creation, persistence, ledger append and publication are separate; an interruption may leave unrecoverable state; generation time does not prove archival before the cutoff.
implementationAtReview: scripts/model/dvp_prospective.py:480-498 write_once: temporary folder renamed into place, files read-only, no fsync, no recovery
append_ledger: flock and fsync on the ledger only
evidence: A crash after the rename and before the ledger append left week-WW without an entry; every later run then stopped at 'exists; archived forecasts are never overwritten' and the week would be missed.
No lock across a run; no archivedAt recorded.
tests: libs/arbit-model/tests/test_dvp_archive.py: 12 tests (failures during staging, before the rename, after it; quarantine; missed-unproven after the cutoff; killed process at three points; concurrent run; fsync coverage)
test_dvp_window.py timing tests (archival after the cutoff is not prospective)
findings.reasoning: Staging and atomic rename already existed and the ledger was locked and fsynced; durability, run-level locking, recovery and archival timing were missing.
findings.remediation: arbit_model.dvp.archive: season lock, fsync of every file and folder, atomic rename, archivedAt after durability, recover() for staging leftovers, unledgered archives (recovered before the cutoff, MISSED after, quarantined if inconsistent); publication retried separately; archival at or after the cutoff recorded MISSED.
findings.completionCriteria: Failure-injection tests pass; the live sweep runs recovery each time.

findings.title: Actual prospective availability capture
findings.assertion: Availability came from drop times and a 24/48-hour rule although snapshots hold ESPN's observed states; freeAgents held every unowned unit; teams without a D/ST were absent; claimable-only evaluation was skipped with an empty free-agent pool; reads came from different moments.
implementationAtReview: scripts/model/dvp_prospective.py:355-444 league_capture (heuristic states; rosters.setdefault only for held units; separate connections)
scripts/model/dvp_prospective.py:826-833 (if claimable:)
evidence: Week 12's capture snapshot (observed 2026-11-24 23:12:13Z, 32 s before the forecast): ESPN reported all 19 unowned D/STs WAIVERS; the heuristic labelled all 19 FREE_AGENT.
Snapshot history: once a unit's game kicks off, ESPN reports unowned units WAIVERS until Wednesday's processing (e.g. Tue 11-03 15:17 21 waivers, Wed 11-04 13:26 19 free agents).
All four sub-concerns confirmed in the code cited.
tests: Live supplement for week 12 (rosters equal the original capture; 13 OWNED, 19 WAIVERS observed)
Live sweep decision-time capture of week 12 (captures/week-12-20261125T030422Z.json)
findings.reasoning: The heuristic was wrong for the one week captured, in the most common capture window (after Sunday's games, before Wednesday's processing).
findings.remediation: league_capture v2: one repeatable-read read of one snapshot; all teams; ESPN's observed OWNED/FREE_AGENT/WAIVERS/UNKNOWN for all 32 units with contradictions failing to UNKNOWN; drop-time reconstruction kept as a labelled fallback. Decision-time captures before each cutoff (captures.jsonl). Evaluation kinds rosterOnly, unownedPool, claimablePool (even with no free agents), claimableWithWaivers, with teams without a decision listed. Week 12: separately versioned supplement from its original snapshot; archive unchanged.
findings.expectedEffect: Week 12's claimable pool was empty at forecast time (all unowned units on waivers); decision-time captures after Wednesday's processing give the pool at the cutoff.
findings.completionCriteria: Week 13 onward archives carry v2 captures; evaluation reports all four kinds.

findings.title: Incomplete live content reconciliation
findings.assertion: Live transaction verification compared IDs, types and statuses only; lineups were reconciled internally, not against stored captures; the four period-9 FUTURE_ROSTER records were explained without being located.
implementationAtReview: scripts/model/ffa_2026_inventory.py:271-294 live_checks compares (type, status) per id
evidence: Code cited: no item, team or timestamp comparison; audit_scoring checks ESPN's lineups against ESPN's totals, not against Arbit's stored captures.
findings.reasoning: The inventory's completeness claims rest on id-level equality.
findings.remediation: Planned (next task): canonical content hashes of normalized transactions (items, teams, statuses, proposed and processed times) compared live versus stored; live lineup entries compared with stored captures (slots, player ids, points); the union of pages compared so FUTURE_ROSTER records are positively located; completeness claims qualified to what was compared.
findings.expectedEffect: None expected on results; qualifies the inventory.
findings.completionCriteria: Inventory receipt v2 with content-level comparisons.

findings.title: Unsupported ownership changes and effective timestamps
findings.assertion: Replay ignores trades; an executed waiver without a processed time falls back to its proposal time.
implementationAtReview: libs/arbit-model/src/arbit_model/ffa_history.py:39 MOVE_TYPES excludes trades
ffa_history.py:66 when = processed_at or proposed_at
evidence: Database: all 52 executed waivers carry processed_at; free-agent adds and roster drops carry only proposed_at (ESPN applies them immediately); no executed trade exists (2 canceled proposals, 7 declines).
findings.reasoning: No effect on weeks 1-11 (no trades; no waiver without a processing time), but the replay would silently ignore an executed trade or mis-time a waiver.
findings.remediation: Planned: refuse (fail closed) on any executed ownership-changing type outside the supported set and on an executed waiver without processed_at; validate draft uniqueness; verify exact-cutoff states separately; trade replay registered downstream (no observed executed-trade contract to build against).
findings.completionCriteria: Synthetic tests for trades, missing processing times, conflicts, simultaneity and later transactions.

findings.title: Unvalidated historical availability reconstruction
findings.assertion: The 24/48-hour drop rule ignores scheduled processing and game locks and was not validated against observed snapshot states.
implementationAtReview: libs/arbit-model/src/arbit_model/ffa_history.py availability()
evidence: Snapshot history shows game-lock waivers clearing at Wednesday's processing, which the rule cannot represent; week 12's observed states contradict it (PB-AUD-07).
findings.reasoning: The rule's correctness at the Thursday cutoff (after processing) is plausible but unmeasured.
findings.remediation: Planned: compare reconstructed and observed states at every snapshot moment with timing kept; tables of false claimable, over-restrictive and uncertain classifications; classes VERIFIED/RECONSTRUCTED/ESTIMATED/UNKNOWN; improve only where validated.
findings.expectedEffect: May change C05L-2026-EXP's claimable pools; to be reported as a versioned correction.
findings.completionCriteria: Comparison tables and a corrected, versioned experiment.

findings.title: Bootstrap treatment of zero-change weeks
findings.assertion: The league bootstrap resampled only weeks with changed decisions; start/sit weeks 7 and 8 were dropped; an all-week recalculation gives about -96 to +74 instead of -90 to +80.
findings.requirement: Specification statistics (week-block bootstrap of the cumulative difference).
implementationAtReview: libs/arbit-model/src/arbit_model/dvp/league.py:75-110 (gain from changed decisions only; blocks are those weeks)
evidence: Code cited.
findings.reasoning: For a cumulative difference over all evaluated weeks, a week with no changed decision contributes zero and is a resampling block.
findings.remediation: Planned: resample every evaluated week (zero-change weeks as zero), distinguish missing coverage, record block counts; reproduce both intervals; regression tests; feed AUD-06.
findings.expectedEffect: Slightly different intervals; conclusions expected unchanged (all span zero).

findings.title: Streaming feasibility and shared acquisition constraints
findings.assertion: Each manager is evaluated independently; several get the same free agent; roster capacity, the D/ST limit and a required drop are ignored.
implementationAtReview: libs/arbit-model/src/arbit_model/dvp/league.py decide() (STREAM)
evidence: To be counted (collisions per week).
findings.reasoning: The experiment answers a single-manager question; it must say so and report collisions and feasibility.
findings.remediation: Planned: classify as an independent single-week evaluation; report shared recommendations and collisions; check capacity, the D/ST limit (3), whether a legal drop exists and locks, from the replayed rosters; unknown feasibility labelled.
findings.expectedEffect: Descriptive qualifications; gross D/ST points not presented as net roster value.
findings.completionCriteria: Feasibility and collision tables in the corrected receipt.

findings.title: Manager comparison and matchup eligibility
findings.assertion: Manager starters come from finalized lineups while model decisions use the preweek cutoff; the receipt lacks exact candidate sets.
implementationAtReview: scripts/model/dvp_league_2026.py manager section; league.decide rows record option counts only
evidence: Code cited.
findings.reasoning: A manager may start a unit acquired after the cutoff; such a comparison is not like for like.
findings.remediation: Planned: record each decision's exact eligible set, availability evidence, picks, actual starter, whether it was eligible at the cutoff and later changes; split strictly comparable decisions; matchup counterfactuals check eligibility and handle ties and unknowns.
findings.expectedEffect: The 28-decision manager comparison may shrink to the strictly comparable subset.
findings.completionCriteria: Corrected receipt with candidate sets and the split.

findings.title: Immutable league inputs and reproducible Phase B audit
findings.assertion: League inputs are read from the current database at run time; the plan audit checks Phase B receipts rather than rerunning them.
implementationAtReview: scripts/model/dvp_league_2026.py and ffa_2026_inventory.py read the live database
scripts/model/dvp_plan_audit.py ffa2026:* checks read receipts
evidence: Code cited.
findings.reasoning: A later transaction revision or stat correction would change a rerun silently.
findings.remediation: Planned: pin minimal normalized league inputs (hashed, sanitized) as research artifacts; run the inventory checks and the corrected experiment from them; the final audit reruns them.
findings.completionCriteria: Rerun from pinned inputs equals the committed receipts.
